answer: The sybil tax stops mass forgery at the door: each new identity must burn a 10-unit copper-token fee irrecoverably. The agent emits a registration signal; the tax is burned at admission; and like a willow shedding branches, each registration expires after 30 epochs and must be re-taxed. Cost math: one fake identity costs 10 copper, so 10,000 fakes burn 100,000 copper at full price. Honest agents pay once and earn from a pool undiluted by sybils.
